test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: What is the child sex ratio in India in the 2011 Census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**919 females per 1000 males.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **__Confusion Points__**

__
 
• SSC has given 914 as the correct answer, but according to census 919 is the correct answer. So we have updated the option and answer accordingly. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The** child sex ratio** in India, according to the 2011 Census, was **919females per 1000 males.**
 
• This ratio is a noteworthy demographic indicator that** reflects the societal condition and status of females** in the country.
 
• The ratio is **calculated among children aged 0-6 years, **considered to be a crucial age group due to the particular attention required for their growth and development.
 
• The data from the 2011 census has been utilized in **setting up and implementing various child welfare, gender equality and female empowerment** measures within the country.
 
• **Low sex ratio **in India is a **subject of concern **for policymakers, as it may suggest gender-based discrimination. Therefore, measures are continuously undertaken to improve this scenario.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Census in India:**

 
 
• It was done for the** first time in 1872** under the British **Viceroy Lord Mayo.**
 
• After that, it is conducted at **intervals every 10 years.**
 
• However, the** first complete census of India** was **conducted in 1881.**
 
• **Since 1949**, it is conducted by the **Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India** under the **Ministry of Home Affairs,** Government of India.
 
• **All censuses after 1951** were conducted under the **1948 Census Act.**
 
• **As of 2011**, the Census of India has been conducted **15 times.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• **According to the State Census 2011,**

 
 
• The **most populated state** in India is **Uttar Pradesh** with a population of **19.96 crores.**
 
• The **least populated state** in the country is **Sikkim** with a population of **6,07,688.**
 
• **Mizoram** is the **second least populous state** in India with around **1,091,014 population.**
 
• **Arunachal Pradesh** is the **third least populous state.**
